open_work: Two original urn/body/lid/tap/gauge groups and one original empty pie case retain their combined plan envelopes and source upper datums, on the actual fitted backbar top at 1.02m. Original reference boxes remain hidden and exact.

Closed hollow nickel vessel shells, fitted lids, hollow brass spouts and glass sight tubes replace the source boxes. Bounded join stocks bridge the original .01m lid separation and attach the offset gauge to its vessel. These are passive construction adaptations, with no invented beverage, contents, pressure, heat or utility authority.

Thin framed empty pie-case panes and two empty shelf sheets use the existing glass/timber/brass finishes. Food/drink service, stock, opening animations, utilities, capacity, continuous routes, optical glare and human acceptance remain open. The added pie-case floor uses the existing registered timber catalogue owner; original nickel, brass and glass use the retired source owners.
